description: Attests to a subject's completed onchain credit position without exposing exact balances or transaction history.
encoding: abi.encode(uint256 protocolChainId,address protocol,bytes32 marketId,bytes32 positionRef,uint8 outcome,uint64 openedAt,uint64 closedAt)
issuerPolicy: Issuer must be the protocol, its governance-authorized indexer, or an auditor authorized for this schema.
name: SOVA Onchain Credit Performance
revocation: Issuer must revoke claims affected by reorg, indexing error, or adjudicated dispute.
